title: Tree-linked EM9305 typed-RAM image: NVM slot-fit, private NOR splice, paired Renode sims
scope: Emulator only. No hardware flash. No git commit/push/stash/reset. Official opencfw-otap-disarm.app.bin was not overwritten (mtime still 2026-11-22 07:55:05 CST, sha256 7c691d8ce955479f748554628107e977cc723ef945b6509dcd00dae1aac625dd). Single-writer approval used only for g2/src/em9305/link/g2-em9305.ld. Did not edit sources.json, tools/build/*.py, docs, include/*.h, or ~/Repo/g2-firmware-emulator. Other streams' Renode runs were left running.

tree_build.tool: build/ws-em9305-20261122/pbuild.py (default --ld is the tree linker script)

package.method: em9305_record2.split_bootloader_image + finalize via split_flat_image; record_package.build_package with last_page=(APP_BASE+len(app)-NVM_BASE+0x1FFF)//0x2000

slot_fit.note: Fit is against the EM9305 main NVM window 0x00300000..0x00380000 and the official record2 ASSERTs (bootloader must not reach 0x00302000; app must not pass 0x00380000), not merely size vs stock. Precomputed programmed-NVM CRCs of our record extents: [0x00300000,0x00300488)=1D6121C4, [0x00302000,0x00302038)=D26E58C4, [0x00302400,0x0033D8B4)=3A77CC5C.

splice.private_g2_app_note: Byte-identical private copy of official opencfw-otap-disarm.app.bin. Official file was not opened for write.
splice.nor_source: copy of build/em9305-nor-20261122/nor-stock-formatted.bin, then lfs_inject at 0x1400000 path firmware/ble_em9305.bin

version_match.compared_to: opencfw-otap-disarm version-match baseline (same CHIPREV/OTAP/HOST 0x3A/UNSUPPORTED 0/advertising 010A200101/display hash/END_PC 0x543528/56 HCI log lines). Full match.
version_match.verdict: PASS: identical to known version-match baseline

forced_mismatch_dfu.opcode_histogram_vs_stock: Identical opcodes and counts except FD03 (987 vs stock 857), explained by the larger 3-record source package (244200 B vs stock 211948 B).

crc32_results.note: Fourth FC4E is 014EFC080000000000000000 — empty window after our 3 records. Stock baseline used a 4th real record window [0x00302400,0x00335BC8).

forced_mismatch_dfu.crc_differs_from_stock_baseline_because: Spliced payload is the tree-built 3-record C package, not the official 4-record stock 4.4.2.0 image. Our bootloader is one 1160-byte record ending 0x00300488 (not stock rec0 224 B + rec1 656 B). Record 2 is finalized for our 242868 B app (CRC D26E58C4, not stock DA9653E5). App window is [0x00302400,0x0033D8B4), not stock [0x00302400,0x00335BC8). Observed CRCs match the precomputed programmed-NVM digests of our records exactly.

compare.verdict: Version-match is a full baseline pass. Forced-mismatch DFU completed the known handshake (4 FC4E, commit 00020404, SYSRESETREQ, SBL app handoff, advertising, display hash, HOST 0x3A after handoff) but CRC windows/values and FD03/HCI counts differ from the stock-image baselines, as required by splicing our larger 3-record source package instead of official ble_em9305.bin. Observed record CRCs equal the precomputed slot-fit digests.

next_em9305_gap.ranking: Largest remaining untyped RAM-window (0x800000-0x80FFFF) literal site count is still in controller_init.c after the 1,603 typo-RAM access rewrites.

missed_rewrite_known_field.note: Address-as-value (return, uintptr_t init, call arg, leftover pointer cast). First ramgen pass only rewrote canonical *(volatile T *)(uintptr_t)0xADDRu without a following + / - / * / /.

address_as_value_pass.reason_not_installed: Private p-addr build of the rewritten body failed at 2026-11-22 5:21:32 PM CST (America/Chicago), rc=2, -Werror=array-bounds. Example: opencfw_em9305_common_callback_3152fc sets root to 0x8015c4 and then writes *(uint16_t *)root, *(uint32_t *)(root+8/12/16/20) — a >=24-byte record — but typo-RAM object em9305_ram_8015c4 is only uint8_t u8_8015c4 (size 1). Taking (uintptr_t)&em9305_ram_8015c4.u8_8015c4 lets GCC see the 1-byte object. Tree controller_init.c was restored to the proven pre-pass sha256 0cfaf51e12bcf041496440fda306d55371ff1b6c3fd0539e52b01ef6064e5639, which matches the tree-built p-tree image used in the paired sims.

next_em9305_gap.next_chunk: Grow and add typo-RAM objects from recorded base+offset uses (addresses used as record bases, not just scalar canonical accesses), then redo the address-as-value rewrite so &field spans are wide enough for -Werror=array-bounds. After controller_init, initializer_lowers (top: init_native_scan_child_31eac8.c, 71 sites / 50 unique) and residual/copied C (stock_residual_code.c, bootloader, qk_port_swi).
